feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 27 September 2026 6:06am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 27 September 2026 at 5:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving area of low pressure near Iceland, with another low south of Ireland, tracking northeast. Various fronts affecting Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

South or southeast 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 this morning, veering west in the afternoon, decreasing 4 or 5 this evening, then west or southwest 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, possibly moderate to rough in a few places for a time, falling slight overnight.


##Weather##

Rain, heavy at times, clearing through the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor at times in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, backing south or southwest tomorrow morning, then south or southeast in the afternoon. Increasing east or southeast 5 or 6 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
